title: hello v1
description: Sent by a desktop or phone to the relay as the first message on every connection. It does two jobs: introduce the device, and say where it left off. Fields marked x-deskaway-trust `verified` are checked by the relay against the authenticated connection; `self-reported` fields are claims the relay cannot check and must never be presented as fact.

role.description: Which kind of device this is. Verified: must match the role the device authenticated as, or the relay closes with device-mismatch.

deviceId.description: The device's id. Verified: must match the authenticated device, or the relay closes with device-mismatch.

os.description: Operating system and version, as the device describes itself. Self-reported.

appVersion.description: The DeskAway app version. Self-reported, but lets the relay turn away a client too old to speak this contract before a mismatch causes silent wrongness.

folder.description: Desktop only. The folder the desktop says it will confine work to. Self-reported: scope is a carried value, not an OS-enforced wall, and the relay cannot verify it. It is shown on the phone's approval screen as the desktop's claim, not a guarantee.

scopeVersion.description: Desktop only. Version of the scope rules the desktop is enforcing. Self-reported.

lastSeenSequence.description: The highest relay.sequence this device received in the session it is resuming. Absent on a first connection. The relay resends everything after it.
